# insightfinder_jira (Resource)

Manages InsightFinder Jira integration.

## Example Usage

### Basic Configuration

```terraform
resource "insightfinder_jira" "basic" {
  account          = "user@company.com"
  service_host     = "https://company.atlassian.net/"
  api_token        = var.jira_api_token
  system_names     = ["Production"]
  jira_project_key = "II"
  jira_reporter_id = "5f9b2c1e4b0f8e001a2b3c4d"
}
```

### Full Configuration with Field Update Rules

```terraform
resource "insightfinder_jira" "full" {
  account      = "user@company.com"
  service_host = "https://company.atlassian.net/"
  api_token    = var.jira_api_token
  system_names = [
    "Production-US-East",
    "Production-US-West",
  ]
  jira_project_key = "II"
  jira_reporter_id = "5f9b2c1e4b0f8e001a2b3c4d"

  options        = ["Detected Incident", "Predicted Incident", "Root Cause"]
  content_option = ["SUMMARY", "RECOMMENDATION"]

  # Default assignee for created tickets
  jira_assignee_id = "5f9b2c1e4b0f8e001a2b3c4e"

  # Transition tickets to this status when the InsightFinder incident resolves
  jira_close_status_id = "31"

  # Extra fields to set at ticket-creation time
  jira_issue_fields = {
    "customfield_10010" = "some-value"
  }

  # Custom description template + placeholder-to-field mapping
  description_template = "Incident: {{title}}\nRoot cause: {{rootCause}}"
  template_field_mapping = {
    "title"     = "summary"
    "rootCause" = "customfield_10020"
  }

  # Post-creation field patches, gated by root-cause project/metric/component match
  field_update_rules = [
    {
      projects = ["AccessParks"]
      field_id = "customfield_10050"
      value    = "High"
      enabled  = true
    },
  ]
}

variable "jira_api_token" {
  description = "Jira API token generated for the account"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Jira account email/username.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Jira API token generated for the account (not the account's login password).
- `jira_project_key` (String) Jira project key that created tickets belong to (e.g., 'II').
- `jira_reporter_id` (String) Jira account ID to set as the reporter on created tickets.
- `service_host` (String) Jira instance base URL (e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/). A trailing slash is added automatically if omitted.
- `system_names` (Set of String) InsightFinder system names to associate with this Jira integration. At least one is required.

### Optional

- `content_option` (Set of String) Content sections to include in the Jira ticket. Must be 'SUMMARY' and/or 'RECOMMENDATION'.
- `description_template` (String) Template used to render the Jira ticket description.
- `field_update_rules` (Attributes List) Ordered post-creation field-update rules: when a ticket's project/metric/component match, field_id is set to value after creation (reaches fields that are not on the issue type's create screen). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_update_rules))
- `jira_assignee_id` (String) Jira account ID to assign created tickets to. Leave unset to not set an assignee.
- `jira_close_status_id` (String) Jira status ID to transition a ticket to when the InsightFinder incident is resolved.
- `jira_issue_fields` (Map of String) Additional Jira issue fields to set at ticket-creation time (field ID/name to value).
- `options` (Set of String) Notification types that trigger Jira ticket creation (e.g., 'Detected Incident', 'Predicted Incident', 'Root Cause').
- `template_field_mapping` (Map of String) Mapping of template placeholder names to Jira field IDs, used with description_template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for the Jira configuration (account@service_host).

<a id="nestedatt--field_update_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_update_rules`

Required:

- `field_id` (String) Jira field ID to update (e.g., 'customfield_10050').
- `value` (String) Value to set on field_id.

Optional:

- `components` (List of String) Root-cause component names this rule matches. Empty/omitted matches all.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is active.
- `field_name` (String) Human-readable name of the field, for documentation purposes.
- `metrics` (List of String) Root-cause metric names this rule matches. Empty/omitted matches all.
- `projects` (List of String) Root-cause project names this rule matches. Empty/omitted matches all.
- `value_type` (String) Type of the value being set (e.g., 'string', 'option'), used to shape the update payload.

## Import

Jira integrations can be imported using the format `account@service_host`:

```shell
terraform import insightfinder_jira.example user@company.com@https://company.atlassian.net/
```

`api_token` is never returned by the API, so it is not populated by an import. Set it
in configuration; the first `terraform apply` after the import writes it back.

## Notes

- Use a Jira **API token**, not the account password. Generate one at
  `id.atlassian.com` > **Security** > **API tokens**. The provider sends it to
  InsightFinder, which derives and stores the encoded credential itself.
- `jira_reporter_id` and `jira_assignee_id` are Jira **account IDs**, not usernames or
  email addresses. Look yours up with:
  ```shell
  curl -su '<account-email>:<api-token>' \
    https://<site>.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/myself | jq -r .accountId
  ```
- `service_host` is the Jira site root (e.g. `https://company.atlassian.net/`). A
  trailing slash is added automatically if omitted. InsightFinder stores the value with
  `rest/api/` appended, so the UI and the list API show
  `https://company.atlassian.net/rest/api/` for a resource configured with the site root
  — this is expected and does not cause plan drift.
- `account` and `service_host` together identify the integration. Changing either one
  forces a new resource.
- `options` and `content_option` are sets — order does not matter and will not cause
  plan drift.
- System names are automatically resolved to system IDs internally.
- `field_update_rules` apply *after* the ticket is created, which is how they can reach
  fields that are not on the issue type's create screen.
